description.value: Frank's Honeybun Café is a Yates Street diner that bridges all-day North American breakfast with a full Chinese cuisine menu — wonton soups, udon noodles, stir-fry lunch combos, and more. The broad, eclectic menu makes it a practical refueling stop for cyclists at any time of day. Real fruit smoothies and bubble teas are also on offer alongside the full food menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and confirms the OSM name, address (605 Yates St, Victoria, BC V8W1L2), and phone (250-383-3231). The site prominently features online ordering with a '15 min' pickup option, and the menu legend explicitly lists a 'vegetarian' tag used on items such as Vegetarian Combo and Vegetable Egg Foo Young. No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenity information appears anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in downtown Victoria with a working website and online ordering. A practical stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu legend lists 'vegetarian' as a tagged label; menu includes Vegetarian Combo and multiple Vegetable Egg Foo Young options. No vegan or GF claims confirmed

wow_evidence: all-day North American breakfast with a full Chinese cuisine menu
